properties.html:
Raj invited 8 of his friends - Ravi, Manoj, Priya, Pranesh, Prajesh, Ishaan, Ruth and Tej - for the celebration of his birthday party. His parents had planned for 3 kinds of snacks for the party, Pastries (P), Cookies (C) and Chocolate (T). Each friend of Raj get at least one snack of each type and not more than 7 snacks of any type. The following diagram represents the distribution of three types of snacks to his 8 friends.

Moreover Ravi, Manoj, Priya and Prajesh all received equal number of snacks in total. Interestingly, Raj distributed the toffees in such a way that the number of Pastries, Cookies and Chocolate for each of these four friends are in the form of three distinct natural numbers and the combination of these three numbers were identical but in any order for all the four friends.
If Tej and Ruth received equal number of snacks, then what is the maximum number of snacks received by them?
